english.title: Remote pilot fly tethered aircraft under 250g in breach of fitness to fly
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a remote pilot, flew a tethered small unmanned aircraft which had a MTOM of less than 250g when the requirements of point UAS.OPEN.060(2)(a) of Part A of the Annex to the Unmanned Aircraft Implementing Regulation relating to fitness to fly were not complied with in relation to that aircraft in that **(..SPECIFY CONTRAVENTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 265E(2)(a)(iv) and (7) and 265F(5)(c) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
